Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. ACME's engineering and data teams were impressed with the latency and the rollout controls. To move toward a trial and procurement, my procurement group needs a quick read on the commercial onboarding steps and paperwork. A few specific questions we didn't finish on the call: 

- Do you support vendor onboarding via our AP portal (we prefer PO issuance) and is Redwood able to accept net-30 invoicing?
- If we choose corporate card for early-stage pilots, do you have a marketplace listing (we use our marketplace to speed approvals)?
- What vendor documents do you need from us to get set up (W-9, banking, certificates)? Any preferred formats?
- Is there a standard vendor packet or a contact on your side for vendor-portal enrollment?

If you can send a short checklist and an expected timeline, I can get this into our AP queue today. We aim to have procurement readiness confirmed by end of next week.

Appreciate your help — tagging procurement here as well: acme.procurement@acmehealth.com

Best,
Jordan Lee

Acme Health

Hi Jordan —

Great to hear — glad the demo landed. Quick answers up front, then a short checklist and next steps below.

Top-level:
- We support both PO (preferred for enterprise) and card (good for pilots). PO invoices are supported net-30 by default; billing ops can discuss alternative terms.
- We are listed on two marketplaces (AWS Marketplace & GCP Marketplace) but onboarding to those catalogs takes 4–8 weeks depending on legal review; card purchases there are immediate once active.
- Standard onboarding docs: W-9 (US), banking details (ACH routing + account), vendor contact, and a copy of your PO remit instructions. We also capture SOC2 audit date and support contact for security questionnaires.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf — this is our standard intake. It includes the fields AP systems typically need and a sample invoice.

Quick checklist for ACME (recommended minimal set to start):
1) Signed W-9 (or W-8 if outside US) — attach to portal/email
2) Vendor contact (email + billing contact)
3) Banking details for ACH (optional if you plan to pay by card)
4) Confirm preferred payment method: PO (recommended) / Corporate card / Marketplace
5) PO sample or PO issuance timeline (if PO route)
6) Any required contract redlines flagged to legal

Next steps / timeline proposal:
- Today: I’ll send the onboarding packet (attached) and loop Billing Ops (Ben) to flag net-30 terms.
- By EOD tomorrow: ACME confirms preferred payment channel and attaches W-9.
- By EOW: Redwood sends vendor-portal invite and first invoice template; Billing Ops confirms payment terms.

Action items for our side: 
- Dev Patel will be the onboarding SE and will coordinate the technical handoff once the vendor record is created.
- Neha will support procurement questions and escalate any legal checklist items.

Is this timeline workable? If so, we can convert this into a short mutual action plan and lock in the pilot start date.

Thanks — I’ll also include a short HubSpot link once I create the deal record.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
